title: How to Use Llama 4 Maverick and Llama 4 Scout via API

facts.fact: Meta released the Llama 4 models, Maverick and Scout, on April 5, 2025.
facts.quote: Released on April 5, 2025, these models leverage a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture

facts.fact: Llama 4 Scout has 17 billion active parameters, 109 billion total parameters, and 16 experts.
Llama 4 Scout has a context window of up to 10 million tokens.
The page states that Llama 4 Scout fits on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU when using INT4 quantization.
facts.quote: It fits on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU with INT4 quantization.

facts.fact: Llama 4 Maverick has 17 billion active parameters, 400 billion total parameters, and 128 experts.
Llama 4 Maverick has a context window of up to 1 million tokens.
Groq lists Llama 4 Scout input pricing at $0.11 per million input tokens.
Groq lists Llama 4 Maverick input pricing at $0.50 per million input tokens.
The page says Llama 4 Maverick hosting on local hardware can require NVIDIA H100 DGX systems, which is why it recommends using managed APIs.
facts.quote: which often requires significant hardware (e.g., NVIDIA H100 DGX for Maverick)
